learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry or escalation to ensure critical files like PKGBUILD are always audited
When a model fails on a critical file, the audit system should not mark the package as 'inconclusive' but should either retry or escalate to a stronger model
The audit tool should distinguish between 'no issues found' and 'audit incomplete due to tool error' to avoid false inconclusive verdicts
